title: Built a Beyblade inspired game with Codex while waiting on my 5hr Claude limit to reset
author: Gambo7592
selftext:
Spent wayyy to long on this. trying to kill time waiting on my 5hr Claude window to come back lol   
It's gotten out of hand 😅  
  
6 spinners with signature abilities, 4 arenas with different physics, a 3D open world survival mode, an arena workshop where you design your own stadiums, online multiplayer with private rooms, and even Elo for ranked play.

**How it was made:**

* All code written by Astra
* All 3D rendering is Three.js
* Spinner models: Gemini for the 2D art → Meshy for the 3D conversion
* World assets are Quaternius
* Hosted on Netlify, Cloudflare Workers for multiplayer
* Had Astra make the trailer too bc why not lmao

Play it free: [ripitarena.app](http://ripitarena.app)   
Plays best on computer with a control but keyboard/mouse and mobile work well too!
